name: Guide to Fortitude
desc:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Fortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.
It brings forth the will to grow. Though shattered by the bitter cold, a fragile seed can still harness this will to break through the frozen earth, pushing forth fresh sprouts to life across a landscape blanketed in wind and snow.

customize.name: Teachings of Fortitude
customize.desc:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Fortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.
It stems from a raw yearning for survival. Even if scattered far from fertile soil, a fragile seed can rely on this desperate longing to drive its roots deep beneath the frozen tundra.

customize.name: Alyosha
customize.desc: A "professional hunter" and master of the Snezhnayan snowfields. A fierce, distinct "idealism" burns beneath his calm demeanor.

customize.name: Philosophies of Fortitude
customize.desc:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Fortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.
It breeds the prosperity of life itself. The people here have never bowed to the biting cold, just as a fragile seed defiantly chooses to bloom amidst the blizzards. This civilization has witnessed centuries of bitter winter, yet remains vibrant much like the Frostfairy Flower that flourishes season after season.
